### Observed differences

In the later window, activities A14, A17, A20, and A21 appear later in traces (mean position rises from about 0.34 to about 0.68–0.69), while A15, A16, A18, and A19 appear earlier (mean position falls from about 0.63 to about 0.39). [POS001, POS004, POS007, POS008, POS002, POS003, POS005, POS006]  
The order between these two groups reverses: for example, A14 preceded A15 in about 25% of cases before, but A15 preceded A14 in about 23% after; A15 preceded A22 in all cases before, but A22 preceded A15 in all cases after. [REL001, REL010, REL015, REL023]  
Successor relations also swap: A14, A17, A20, and A21 now lead to A27 instead of A22, while A15, A16, A18, and A19 now lead to A22 instead of A27. [DIR001, DIR004, DIR007, DIR008, DIR002, DIR003, DIR005, DIR006]  
A26 and A37 also swap their successor sets. [DIR009, DIR010]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. Although many indicators agree, they all reflect a single underlying reordering, and the number of distinct differences is not clearly above the number expected by chance.
